articles.title: A Baby Turkey, a Feather Duster Mom, and a Best Friend
articles.summary: A baby turkey and a mourning dove raised together at a Pennsylvania wildlife center became inseparable, and were released together so they could choose their own paths.

articles.title: The Pokemon Game That Was Supposed to Delete Itself Is Back
articles.summary: A collector has found the only known playable copy of PokePark: Fishing Rally, a 2005 Pokemon DS game designed to erase itself after 12 hours.

articles.title: Crows Decide Twice as Fast as Humans
articles.summary: Crows in a German study decided which way dots were moving in just 235 milliseconds, twice as fast as humans, with near-perfect accuracy.
